snippet.title: Serious Sam: The Third Encounter | Official Teaser
snippet.description:
Serious Sam: The Third Encounter is the new long-awaited entry in the cult-classic series, bringing pure arcade FPS action to bold new worlds packed with deadly enemies, overwhelming odds, and serious firepower. Bigger hordes. Bigger enemies. Bigger guns. One last score to settle with Mental.

WISHLIST NOW on Steam for the latest news and updates on Serious Sam: The Third Encounter.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/459920/Serious_Sam_The_Third_Encounter/
